description: The RTO/ISO may impose a minimum aggregated-resource size (up to 100 kW), whereas the registration process previously could not include any minimum size requirement.

prior_citation.verification_rationale:
"shall not include a minimum size
requirement for the aggregated resources"

new_citation.verification_rationale:
"may
establish a minimum size requirement for the aggregated resources that
does not exceed 100 kW"

confidence_rationale: Strongly supported: the prior text forbids any minimum-size requirement, and the new text allows one (explicit 100 kW cap), implying added size constraint for aggregators.

description: The aggregator must register each distributed energy resource at least 60 days before it participates and must include the point of interconnection in the registration details.

prior_citation.verification_rationale:
"The registration shall
include the physical location of each distributed energy resource and
its physical and operational characteristics"

new_citation.verification_rationale:
"at least 60 days before the
distributed energy resource participates in the aggregation. The
registration shall include the physical location, the point of
interconnection, and the physical and operational characteristics"

confidence_rationale: Reasonable: the new text clearly adds (i) a 60-day timing requirement and (ii) a point-of-interconnection field, but the prior timing absence is inferred from not being stated in the provided prior passage.

description: In addition to providing information to confirm capability, the aggregator must provide a telemetry feed for aggregated resources rated at or above 100 kW.

prior_citation.verification_rationale:
"shall provide the Regional Transmission Organization
or Independent System Operator with information sufficient to permit
the Regional Transmission Organization or Independent System Operator
to confirm"

new_citation.verification_rationale:
"and shall
provide a telemetry feed for aggregated resources rated at or above 100
kW"

confidence_rationale: Strongly supported: the telemetry-feed requirement is explicitly added and is an added compliance deliverable for aggregators (tightening rather than a wholly standalone new obligation).
